themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with tools, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in evaluating the ease of use and effectiveness of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting job roles, skill requirements, hiring practices, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques used to extract insights, identify patterns, and interpret data from various sources.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that bridge the gap between design processes and research findings.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers studies and discussions around the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and societal impact of AI chatbots.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial users for testing and research purposes, including their implications and detectability.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in analyzing qualitative data, conducting interviews, and understanding nuanced user perspectives.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
